text:
Elena (People Ops): Hey everyone — rolling out two related updates today: 1) Global PTO Exceptions framework for region-specific public holidays and emergency leave; 2) Workcation guidance (short-term remote work from another country). Full doc: https://handbook.redwood.example/workculture/pto-workcation. TL;DR below.

Maya: thanks! does this change accruals or carryover?

Elena (People Ops): Good q — accrual cadence stays the same. We added an explicit carryover exception tier for employees in countries with fixed statutory holidays that don't align with our US calendar. That exception auto-increases carryover by +5 days for those regions.

Jon: who qualifies for the +5?

Elena (People Ops): Folks whose employment contract is governed by those local labor laws (list in doc). If you're unsure, check the FAQ or ping me.

Priya: Workcation — is manager approval enough or do we need legal/infra signoff for VPN/access?

Elena (People Ops): Manager approval + automated infra checklist. For <30 days: manager approval and check the <#eng-security> checklist link in the doc. For 30+ days or travel to high-risk jurisdictions: manager + security signoff + legal if non-EU/EFTA.

Ava: any tax implications we should expect?

Elena (People Ops): We are not providing tax advice. The policy flags potential tax exposure and requires you to confirm you've checked with tax counsel (company can help connect you to recommended advisors). For certain long stays, payroll may require a country onboarding step — again documented.

Maya: What about benefits coverage while on workcation (health, etc)?

Elena (People Ops): Core benefits remain, but regional health plan rules may affect coverage. The doc has a per-country note; if there's a gap, People Ops will contact you directly after you submit a workcation request.

Jon: Is there a limit on number of workcations per year?

Elena (People Ops): Two per calendar year by default. Exceptions can be requested for special programs (e.g., family reasons) and routed to People Ops.

Priya: If I use the +5 carryover, does that affect sabbatical eligibility?

Elena (People Ops): No — sabbatical eligibility thresholds are unchanged. Carryover days are consumed before new-year accrual unless you opt to cash out where applicable.

HR Bot: Reminder: to start a workcation request, use /workcation in Slack. That kicks off the manager approval flow and security checklist.

Ava: Is there a sample manager email or approval text we can use?

Elena (People Ops): Yep — sample text is at the bottom of the doc. You can copy/paste into the approval flow or send directly.

Maya: thanks, appreciated. Can People Ops do a live Q&A next week?

Elena (People Ops): Yes — hosting a 30-min drop-in on Tuesday 11am PT. Calendar invite coming. If you can't make it, drop questions in this thread and I'll answer. :sparkles:
